questions.question:
Identify the sentence with correct inversion due to an adjective clause modifier.

A: The book I read yesterday was very interesting.
B: Yesterday I read the book which was very interesting.
C: The book which was very interesting I read yesterday.
D: Very interesting was the book I read yesterday.
options: The book I read yesterday was very interesting.
Yesterday I read the book which was very interesting.
The book which was very interesting I read yesterday.
Very interesting was the book I read yesterday.
questions.answer: Very interesting was the book I read yesterday.

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location?

A: It was in the garden that the children found the lost dog.
B: The children found the lost dog in the garden.
C: The lost dog was found by the children in the garden.
D: In the garden, the children found the lost dog.
options: It was in the garden that the children found the lost dog.
The children found the lost dog in the garden.
The lost dog was found by the children in the garden.
In the garden, the children found the lost dog.
questions.answer: It was in the garden that the children found the lost dog.

questions.question:
Select the option that correctly uses the subjunctive mood in this context.

If only I _______ the results earlier, I would have told you.

A: knew
B: had known
C: would know
D: could know
options: knew
had known
would know
could know

questions.question:
Which sentence correctly employs ellipsis to maintain grammatical parallelism?

A: She likes swimming in the sea and rowing boats.
B: She likes to swim in the sea and to row boats.
C: She likes that she swims in the sea and rows boats.
D: She likes swimming in the sea and rowing boats as well.
options: She likes swimming in the sea and rowing boats.
She likes to swim in the sea and to row boats.
She likes that she swims in the sea and rows boats.
She likes swimming in the sea and rowing boats as well.
questions.answer: She likes swimming in the sea and rowing boats.

questions.question:
Choose the sentence that uses the appropriate formal register for the given context.

A: I think that the committee should reconsider their decision.
B: It is my opinion that the committee ought to rethink their decision.
C: My view is that the committee must rethink their decision.
D: The committee should rethink their decision, in my opinion.
options: I think that the committee should reconsider their decision.
It is my opinion that the committee ought to rethink their decision.
My view is that the committee must rethink their decision.
The committee should rethink their decision, in my opinion.
questions.answer: It is my opinion that the committee ought to rethink their decision.
